## What you can catch

**Dorado (mahi-mahi).** You can catch dorado year-round. The season peaks from November to April.

**Marlin.** Several species of marlin are found year-round. The peak months for blue marlin are November–December and March–April, while black marlin peaks in July and August.

**Roosterfish.** You can catch roosterfish year-round. They weigh between 10 and 30 kg.

**Sailfish.** You can catch sailfish year-round, with the main season running from November to May. In favourable conditions, it’s possible to catch more than 20 sailfish in a day.

**Snappers and reef perch.** More than a dozen species are found in the area, weighing approximately 6 to 45 kg.

**Tuna.** Yellowfin tuna can reach 200 kg. You can catch young yellowfin year-round. Bigeye tuna are also found here and put up a strong fight when reeled in.

**Wahoo.** Less common, wahoo turn up from time to time.
